description: This file declares the MediaDecoder class for Android shared media decoding, including its interface, callback mechanisms, internal data structures, and method signatures. It is part of the starboard namespace and handles media decoding operations, error handling, and communication with MediaCodecBridge.

classes.name: MediaDecoder
classes.description: A final class managing Android media decoding via MediaCodecBridge, handling input/output buffers, errors, and callbacks, designed for use within the starboard Android shared namespace.

classes.name: Host
classes.description: An interface class for clients to implement to receive notifications from MediaDecoder, such as processing output buffers, handling end-of-stream, format changes, and periodic ticks.

methods.name: MediaDecoder
methods.description: Constructor for MediaDecoder, initializing with host, media info, DRM, and other parameters.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with an error callback.

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for the decoder.
